metadata.title: Sample knowledge hypergraph in HIF (Hypergraph Interchange Format)
metadata.description: Three n-ary facts from a toy biomedical knowledge base. Each hyperedge is one fact; each incidence carries the role the entity plays in that fact. Directed: 'tail' incidences are the inputs/subjects of the relation, 'head' incidences are the outputs/objects.

conventions.edge.attrs.relation: the relation (predicate) type of the n-ary fact
conventions.incidence.attrs.role: the role the node plays in the fact (qualifier-style roles allowed)
conventions.edge.attrs.valid-from: ISO-8601 date the fact became valid
